issues.message: TLS 10.80.0.10:51000 -> 10.80.0.1:443 (SNI edge-1.example.net): chose a suite that does not encrypt: TLS_RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA256 has a NULL cipher: records carry plaintext with only a MAC
TLS 10.80.0.10:51000 -> 10.80.0.1:443 (SNI edge-1.example.net): client offered weak suites TLS_RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA256

limits: Only the cleartext handshake is read. In TLS 1.3 everything after the ServerHello is encrypted: the certificate, the server's extensions and any later alert cannot be seen. In TLS 1.2 and older the certificate is visible and is read here.
Certificate trust (chain to a trusted root, revocation) is not judged; only what the certificate says.
In TLS 1.3 the server's ALPN choice travels in the encrypted EncryptedExtensions message, so server_chose.alpn is null and an ALPN baseline is checked only for TLS 1.2 and older.
With Encrypted Client Hello the visible SNI is the outer, public name, not the real server name.
A handshake split across segments is reassembled from the first bytes of each direction; one that starts before the capture, or whose segments were lost before the capture point, cannot be read.
QUIC, DTLS and STARTTLS are not decoded.

certificate.reason: Certificate message not captured (resumed session, or segments missing)
